title: Giving Up a Seat on a Full Flight
paragraphs: On an overbooked flight, an announcement asks for one volunteer to take a later flight in exchange for a travel voucher, and Widya, who has no urgent plans waiting at home, decides to offer.
A young couple nearby, visibly anxious about missing a family event, thank her repeatedly, since they had been dreading the possibility of being separated onto different flights that evening.
Widya spends an extra three hours at the airport, slightly bored but otherwise unaffected, using the voucher later for a small trip she had been meaning to plan anyway.
Reflecting on the small inconvenience afterward, Widya feels that giving up something minor for herself to genuinely help a stressed couple was a fair and easy trade to make.
